$comment: Per-release derived-data upgrade manifests. Schema migrations handle table SHAPE; entries here declare which DERIVED layers a release invalidates and how to recompute them. Consumed by steps_between(installed, shipped) — see topos/upgrades/__init__.py. Steps MUST be idempotent and safe to re-run after interruption.

releases.summary: Dense intelligence upgrade (stats engine, entity spine, fact store, incremental clustering, query planner). Shipped before manifests existed; entry anchors the version ladder.

Temporal entity graph (facts/goals/places/conversations materialized, provenance roles on edges, Louvain neighborhoods, semantic graph search), NER wordpiece stitcher, derived-data GC hardening, provenance split completion.

steps.title: Re-extract entities with the wordpiece stitcher
steps.why: 5f687e9 changed NER post-processing (word-level aggregation + wordpiece stitching): 1.1.0-era extractions contain ##-fragment junk and silently truncated surfaces ('Jon' for 'Jonny'). Message rows are untouched; message_entities/entity_mentions produced by the old extractor are stale.
steps.idempotent: record_mention is INSERT OR IGNORE; re-running converges
steps.estimated_duration: ~10–20 min per 1.5k records (CPU-bound NER); node stays usable, serves stale graph meanwhile

steps.title: Rebuild the entity graph (evidence + materialized layers)
steps.why: 1.2.0 adds layers the 1.1.0 graph never had: fact/topic/goal/place/conversation materialization, provenance role stamping on edges (attribution overlay), Louvain community ids, and GC for dangling contact anchors / orphaned facts. One rebuild derives all of it from existing data.
steps.progress: synchronous (seconds at personal scale); response is the before/after report
steps.idempotent: full-refresh semantics (mz-tagged edges rebuilt, evidence edges recomputed from mentions)
steps.$comment: Must run AFTER re-extraction completes: rebuilding from a partially restored mention set guts evidence edges (observed live 2026-07-10).

steps.title: actor_role column backfill
steps.why: Handled by the ledger-guarded schema migration actor_role_v1 at first boot; listed so release notes and the fleet dashboard show it without a manifest step.

notes: No re-embedding: the embedding model is unchanged in 1.2.0 (signal_embeddings remain valid).
No canonical re-ingest: raw and canonical rows are untouched by every 1.2.0 change.
Extraction default model moved to the quality tier (qwen3.5:9b-mlx) — affects FUTURE extractions only; small-RAM devices surface tier=stress in model recommendations and should downsize via settings.
Fleet skew: 1.1.0 nodes lack the signal_entity_graph_search handler — CPs must treat it as optional until the fleet is on 1.2.0.
